definitions.boundaries: Measured zero-based63,127,...,4095;64 positions. Ours plans at all64. Other arms are compared at identical job positions.
definitions.neighborhoods: Native launch or in-job commit at step c and c±1. A completion-tail commit is excluded from per-job commit neighborhoods. Neighborhood categories may overlap; do not sum them.
definitions.service: Coordinator finish−start, including native step, inference-stream completion and CPU dispatch/ACK; not exclusive kernel/selector time.
definitions.M64: Sum over resident physical experts of ceil(route_count/64), plus padded rows=64×tiles. Structural nonempty expert tiles, not observed CUDA launch/block count or runtime.
definitions.decomposition: Paired total service difference equals differences at the64 fixed positions plus all other positions. Arithmetic association only, not a causal ablation.

limitations: No selector-only or controller-only timing ablation; event timing cannot identify exclusive component cost.
Work-count and max-rank changes do not imply runtime speedup; kernel execution, overlap, routing and coordination remain measured only in raw service.
Stockoff128slots and ours160slots have different permitted residency; both use one physical home per active logical expert.
Counts use the same constructed hidden jobs; tokens/jobs are not independent statistical observations.
No new confidence intervals, p-values, margins, selection or tuning; final confirmatory inference remains the separately frozen analysis.
